E. Request of Mayor Davis, Mayor Pro Tem O’Day and Councilmember Winterer that the Council support a resolution by the California School Boards Association calling on the state legislature to raise school funding to the national average by 2020 and to the average funding of the top 10 states by 2025. California currently sits near the bottom nationally in nearly every significant measure of school funding and school staffing. While we are fortunate in Santa Monica to have a community that has stepped up to support our district, that approach is not viable for many other cities. To meet the needs of 6.2 million public school students and prepare them for an increasingly competitive, complex, and technological world, the state Legislature must secure Full and Fair Funding for public schools.
